summary: Closed the postponed-read question on its corrected, fully-resolved receipt. CheckRun a1859bb05261498c820729722eef035f (fixed experiment 236a9ffeb4824e6f8ac232cc9fd69ac6-experiment, version 3) parsed twenty-four events with no loss and resolved all ten comparisons: the local witness for the removal case is violated (parsed index 3: postponement at index 2, then a 10 -> 11 commit with committed_entry_term 2 equal to leader_term while pending_reads stayed 1 and no ReadState appeared), the joint-configuration variant is violated (index 11), the heartbeat round does not repair it (index 5), both local controls hold (indices 6 and 14: the unrelated proposal releases the request with ctx A at index 12), the forwarded premises hold (indices 18 and 19), the forwarded witness is violated (index 20: no MsgReadIndexResp and no ReadState on follower 2 although the release condition held) and its control holds (index 23). The account therefore states, on one receipt covering both completion paths, that a ReadIndex request a leader accepts by postponing can stay unanswered across a commit of an entry of its own term when switchToConfig performs that commit - for a local ReadState and for a forwarded MsgReadIndexResp alike - with no periodic or acknowledgement path inside raft repairing it, while the eventual answer stays safe because its index is taken at release time; counterevidence keeps the intact controls, the documented client-retry allowance and the documented applied/ApplyConfChange latitude, and limitations now cover the fixture, the contract-level measurement without a state machine, and the remaining unmeasured premises. The earlier limitation about the four unknown comparisons was dropped because this basis re-measured them, and joint_history records why the three receipts of the harness family are comparable.
